WITH report_counts AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
shares AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo,
         employee_count,
         CAST(employee_count AS REAL) / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM report_counts
)
SELECT ReportsTo,
       employee_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;
